The Indian Women’s Hockey Team opened their FIH Hockey World Cup Belgium & Netherlands 2026 campaign with a hard-fought 2-2 draw against Olympic silver medallists China in their Pool D opener. Navneet Kaur put India ahead with a smart first-touch finish, before Deepika added another with a powerful drag-flick from a penalty corner. China fought back twice to level the score, as both teams ended up sharing the points after an action-packed contest.
Watch the highlights from Indian Women's Team's thrilling World Cup opener against China!
